# netactuate_dedicated_servers (Data Source)

Reads Dedicated Servers visible to the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_dedicated_servers" "example" {
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `servers` (List of Object) Dedicated servers visible to the account. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--servers))
